name: The River at Rancho Mirage
description: The River at Rancho Mirage is an upscale open-air lifestyle center featuring premier shopping, dining, and entertainment along California's Highway 111. With a movie theater, diverse restaurants, and boutique stores set against a scenic desert backdrop, it offers a sophisticated and relaxed shopping experience in the heart of the Coachella Valley. The center regularly hosts events including live talent performances and Battle of the Bands competitions.
demographics: Affluent Coachella Valley residents and tourists, including seasonal visitors and golf resort guests seeking upscale retail and dining options
summary: An upscale open-air lifestyle center in Rancho Mirage offering premier shopping, dining, and entertainment experiences in the desert.
